children.game_version: A simplified expression game focusing on slow arm and hand movements to traditional singing.

seniors.seated_version: Perform upper-body and arm movements while seated comfortably.
seniors.standing_version: Stand with support, focusing entirely on upper body and arm gestures.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Slower tempo with reduced arm range to ensure physical comfort.

music_profile.sound_description: A slower traditional song accompanied by group singing and rhythmic time-beating.

teaching.level_notes: Very loose rules on how to dance to the slower song.
